```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(here)

lulucf <- read.csv(here("data", "lulucf_table4_long.csv"))
settlements <- read.csv(here("data", "lulucf_table4e_settlements.csv"))

tot <- lulucf |>
  filter(gas == "total_co2eq") |>
  mutate(value_mt = value_kt / 1000,
         category = category |>
           str_remove("\\s*\\((\\d+|please specify)\\)$") |>
           str_remove("^[0-9A-Z.]+\\s"))
```

## Data and methods

- **Source:** Norway's 2026 submission to the UNFCCC, Common Reporting Tables (CRT), Table 4 and Table 4.E, inventory years 1990–2024.
- **Processing:** Tables are read and reshaped in R (`readxl`, `dplyr`, `tidyr`). Raw files are not stored in the repository; see README for download instructions.
- **Quality assurance:** Automated checks with `testthat` (see `tests/testthat/`).

## Quality assurance

```{r}
#| label: qa
source(here("R", "qa_functions.R"))

tibble(
  check = c("Missing years", "Duplicate rows",
            "Hierarchy (subcategories = parent)",
            "GWP consistency (AR5)", "Carbon to CO2 (Table 4.E)"),
  issues = c(length(check_years(lulucf)),
             nrow(check_duplicates(lulucf)),
             nrow(check_hierarchy(lulucf)),
             nrow(check_gwp(lulucf)),
             nrow(check_c_to_co2(settlements)))
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Forest land

```{r}
#| label: fig-forest
#| fig-cap: "Net emissions/removals from forest land. Negative values are net removals."
tot |>
  filter(code %in% c("4.A", "4.A.1", "4.A.2")) |>
  ggplot(aes(year, value_mt, colour = category)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mt CO2-eq", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

## All land-use categories

```{r}
#| label: fig-categories
#| fig-cap: "Net emissions/removals by land-use category."
tot |>
  filter(level == 1) |>
  ggplot(aes(year, value_mt, fill = category)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mt CO2-eq", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Forest land converted to settlements

```{r}
#| label: fig-deforestation
#| fig-cap: "Net CO2 emissions from forest land converted to settlements (CRT Table 4.E)."
settlements |>
  filter(code == "4.E.2.a") |>
  ggplot(aes(year, co2_kt / 1000)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey40") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mt CO2") +
  theme_minimal()
```
